segments.name: Electricity Segment
segments.description: Owns and operates geothermal, solar and recovered energy power plants.
segments.evidence: We currently conduct our business activities in three business segments: • Electricity Segment.

revenueModel.text: Utilities pay for the electricity its plants generate.
revenueModel.evidence: In the Electricity segment, we develop, build, own and operate geothermal, solar PV and recovered energy-based power plants in the United States and geothermal power plants in other countries around the world and sell the electricity they generate.
